`reference.avif` is a generated 16 × 12 pixel test image (317 bytes), created locally
with `@napi-rs/canvas`: a solid `#4a88cd` background with a `#d9c983` rectangle at
`(4, 3, 8, 6)`, encoded using `canvas.encode('avif')`. It contains no external artwork
or personal data. Tests retain the actual encoded bytes instead of a fake AVIF header.
